Never slim, reshape, lighten skin or beautify any person; identity exactly as the reference.
Landmarks only from real photo plates; no generated landmarks presented as real; no text or signage in generation.
Religious sites: modest poses outside the gates; no flags, state symbols or political banners as props.
Customer images: private previews only; ads need a separate written ad opt-in.
Copy says 'preview' of style and colour, never a size fit.
